entities.summary: Luis Walton Aburto was a Mexican politician affiliated with the Convergence. From 2012 to 2015, he acted as Municipal President of Acapulco. He previously served as Senator of the LX and LXI Legislatures of the Mexican Congress representing Guerrero and as President of the Convergence between 2010 and 2011.
